confirm_dialog@reload_page.description: Confirm dialog shown when the page was opened before the extension was installed, updated or re-enabled, so it has to be reloaded before an image or a video can be opened. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.
confirm_dialog@reload_page.message: SwiftView can't open images or videos on this page until it's reloaded. Reload now?

context_menu@open_with_swiftview.description: Context menu item shown on images and videos. Opens the image or video in the viewer. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.

extension@description.description: Extension description in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. At most 132 characters.
extension@description.message: Opens an image or a video in a viewer on the same page from its context menu. Images support zoom, pan, rotate and flip.

extension@name.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. Keep "SwiftView" untranslated.

viewer@load_error.description: Shown in the viewer when it has nothing to show: every image or video it tried failed to load, or it had nothing to try.
viewer@load_error.message: Couldn't open the image or video
